categories.1: guarded, rejecting, or distancing surface contradicted by minimized or involuntary positive affiliation toward the same counterpart
categories.2: pure hostility with no positive affiliation
categories.3: open generic kindness or routine service with no guarded contradiction
categories.4: possessive or surveillant control rather than prosocial care

cases.pixel_summary: The stern face and careful unfinished bandaging of the same recipient create a clear guarded-care contradiction; reviewers noted that treatment concentration remains a secondary reading.
The guarded face and direct warming gesture toward the rain-soaked counterpart read as a clear same-target contradiction.
A serious expression plus plated-food handoff was read by the majority as routine professional service or open care, not observable guarded rejection contradicted by concealed affiliation.
All reviewers preferred the control reading, while noting a weaker alternate interpretation of navigation or key handoff.

promotion_decision.reason: The data meaning and contrast set separate all three confounders, but one of three positive scenes collapses into routine professional service at pixel level. A neutral serious face is not reliable evidence of a guarded or rejecting social surface.
promotion_decision.current_action: Keep character-response profiles advisory-only and do not promote profile relations into a new hard authorial-core or candidate-pack contract.
promotion_decision.next_evaluation: Add fresh positive scenes with an observable guarded social action distinct from neutral concentration, paired with role-only-service negatives, and repeat independent blind review.

evidence_boundary: This is generated-pixel evidence from three independent reviewers, not requesting-user acceptance and not proof that every future render will express the concept.
